nodes.name: Start from Module 2
nodes.notes:
📥 INPUT FROM MODULE 2

Receives raw job data from scrapers:
- jobTitle
- companyName
- location
- jobUrl
- sourcePlatform
- etc.

This is the entry point from Module 2.

nodes.name: Apply Keyword Filter
nodes.notes:
🔍 KEYWORD FILTER

PURPOSE: Filter jobs based on keywords

FILTER LOGIC:
1. EXCLUDE jobs with blacklisted keywords
2. SCORE jobs based on preferred keywords (10 pts each)
3. BONUS for priority locations (20 pts)
4. Keep only jobs with score >= 30

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing by default - uses your criteria from config/job-filters.json

TO CUSTOMIZE:
- Edit the arrays in the code:
  - preferredKeywords
  - excludedKeywords
  - priorityLocations
- Adjust minimum matchScore threshold (currently 30)

OUTPUT:
- Filtered jobs with matchScore and matchedKeywords added

nodes.name: Read Existing Jobs from Sheet
nodes.notes:
📊 READ FROM GOOGLE SHEETS

⚠️ SETUP REQUIRED:

1. Configure Google Sheets credential (same as Module 1)
2. Set Document ID: Your Google Sheet ID
3. Set Sheet Name: 'Jobs'
4. Operation: 'Read Rows'

PURPOSE: Read all existing jobs to check for duplicates

OUTPUT: Array of all jobs currently in your sheet

WHY NEEDED:
- Deduplication logic needs to know what jobs already exist
- Prevents adding same job twice

NOTE: This reads ALL rows, so it may be slow if you have 1000+ jobs.
Consider archiving old jobs monthly.

nodes.name: Deduplicate Jobs
nodes.notes:
🔄 DEDUPLICATION ENGINE

PURPOSE: Remove duplicate jobs already in your sheet

DEDUPE LOGIC:
1. Read all existing job URLs from sheet
2. Compare new jobs against existing URLs
3. Keep only truly new jobs

DEDUPE KEY: Job URL (unique identifier)
- LinkedIn: linkedin.com/jobs/view/123456
- Indeed: indeed.com/viewjob?jk=abc123

WHY URL:
- Most reliable unique identifier
- Same job may have different titles
- Company name may vary slightly

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing! Works automatically.

OUTPUT:
- Only new, unique jobs
- Adds 'duplicateStatus' field

nodes.name: Format for Google Sheets
nodes.notes:
📋 FORMAT FOR SHEETS

PURPOSE: Transform filtered jobs into Google Sheets schema format

MAPPING:
- RSS 'title' → jobTitle
- RSS 'creator' → companyName
- RSS 'link' → jobUrl
- RSS 'pubDate' → postedDate
- RSS 'contentSnippet' → jobDescription

ADDED FIELDS:
- jobId: Generated unique ID
- matchScore: From filtering
- status: 'Discovered'
- dateScraped: Today
- lastUpdated: Current timestamp

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing! Auto-formats to match schema.

OUTPUT: Jobs ready to write to sheet

nodes.name: Any Jobs to Add?
nodes.notes:
✅ CHECK IF JOBS EXIST

PURPOSE: Verify we have jobs to add before proceeding

LOGIC:
- IF jobs exist → Continue to Module 4
- IF no jobs → Skip to end (log 'no new jobs')

WHY NEEDED:
- Prevent errors in downstream modules
- Log when no new jobs found
- Save API calls if nothing to process

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing! Works automatically.

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: Jobs filtered and deduplicated successfully. Ready for Module 4.

nodes.name: Output to Module 4
nodes.notes:
🚀 OUTPUT TO MODULE 4

PURPOSE: Prepare data for next module (Sheets Logger)

OUTPUT DATA:
- filteredJobs: Array of jobs to add
- jobCount: Number of new jobs
- runId: Execution ID
- status: 'Filtered'

NEXT MODULE: Module 4 - Google Sheets Logger
- Will write these jobs to the Jobs tab

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing! Auto-prepares output.

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: No new jobs found after filtering and deduplication. Either all jobs were duplicates or none matched your criteria.

nodes.name: No New Jobs Found
nodes.notes:
⚠️ NO JOBS PATH

TRIGGERED WHEN:
- All jobs were duplicates
- No jobs matched filter criteria
- Scrapers returned empty results

ACTION:
- Log 'No new jobs' status
- Skip resume tailoring (Module 5-7)
- Jump directly to Module 8 (Notifier)

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing! Auto-handles empty state.
